transcript: Ever been asked what an explainer video actually is? It's a short video that explains one thing clearly. Here's the plain-English version.
Every explainer answers one question and moves from problem to answer. Narration explains while visuals show. The goal is understanding, not advertising.
Animation and live action take serious effort. Narrated slides do the same job, and many organisations already explain their biggest ideas in decks.
A reliable shape is situation, problem, answer, proof, next step. Keep words and pictures matched, so when you say order page, viewers see it.
Every extra minute should earn its place. Add captions and readable text, so people watching with the sound off can still follow along.
Your speaker notes become the narration. On Pro, A.I. directs the video, so a plain deck lands like a produced explainer. Try Basic first at powerpoint2vid.com.
